lines.zh: 我跳一下，摊平，再跳一下
lines.en: I hop, flatten, then hop again.

lines.zh: 我的身体是紫黑色的，会拉丝
lines.en: My body is purple-black and pulls into strands.
I splash apart when I land.

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近，速度不快
lines.en: I close in slowly.
Bubbles shift across my surface.

lines.zh: 我跳过一丛草，草被压弯
lines.en: I hop over a clump of grass and bend it.

lines.zh: 我的形状每次都变一点
lines.en: My shape changes a little each time.
I slide a stretch along the ground.
Land, bounce, land again.

lines.zh: 我身上的黏液留下一道印
lines.en: A slime trail marks my path.

lines.zh: 我把身体挤过栅栏的缝
lines.en: I squeeze through a fence gap.
I do not go around; I hop over.
A bit of my edge drips off.

lines.zh: 我在地上滚了半圈，站起来
lines.en: I roll half a turn and rise.

lines.zh: 我朝亮处跳，那里有东西动
lines.en: I hop toward the light; something moves there.
I settle back into shape.

lines.zh: 我摊成一片，安静地待着
lines.en: I flatten out and stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我身上的气泡一个接一个破
lines.en: Bubbles on me pop one after another.

lines.zh: 我的颜色是腐土的那种紫
lines.en: My color is the purple of rotten earth.

lines.zh: 我没有骨头，也没有形状
lines.en: I have no bones, and no fixed shape.
I listen for tremors in the ground.
My surface reflects a dim shine.

lines.zh: 我的一部分慢慢流到边上
lines.en: Part of me slowly spreads to the edge.

lines.zh: 我不需要眼睛也能知道你来了
lines.en: I need no eyes to know you are here.
This patch of ground is damp.
I swell a little.

lines.zh: 一只虫落在身上，被包住了
lines.en: A bug lands on me and is swallowed.
I hold still; I am waiting.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但我朝着你
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I face you.
You stand very near.
My surface ripples once.
Touch me and you will know.
I creep inch by inch to your feet.

lines.zh: 我的身体朝你这边偏了
lines.en: My body leans your way.
I do not fear you; I am hard to grab.
I look like a puddle of muck.

lines.zh: 我的边一直伸到你脚边
lines.en: My edge reaches to your feet.
Will you try stepping on me?

lines.zh: 我被削掉一块，落在地上
lines.en: A piece of me is cut off and falls.

lines.zh: 我的黏液从边上流走一滩。
lines.en: A puddle of me drains off the edge.
I do not cry out; I have no mouth for it.
That made me smaller.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I pull into a lump and slowly swell.
Slime sprays everywhere.
I have no bones to break.
I can make up this loss.
I retreat a short way.
You will need new boots.
Something here; I will just wrap it up.
I am not picky; I digest anything.
I shift a little your way.
Whatever you set down, I will come slowly.
I envelop it, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身体把它整个吞进去
lines.en: My body takes it all in.
This does not dissolve well.
I would like a little more.
Your fingers are far too close to my slime.
Once full, I stop moving.
You step on me and half of me splashes out.
I stick to your boot.
That flattened me.
I slowly swell back.

lines.zh: 我没有硬的地方，撞不疼
lines.en: I have no hard parts; hitting me does not hurt.
I wrap partway around you.
Slime stays on the ground, slippery.

lines.zh: 我们分开时拉出一条丝
lines.en: A strand stretches as we part.
I pull back and flatten out.
You shake, but cannot fling me off.
That cost me some of my mass.
The spot I touched starts to burn.
Your boot punched through one corner of me.
I hop away in a line.

lines.zh: 两只史莱姆撞上，会合起来
lines.en: Two slimes that meet will merge.

lines.zh: 我不分辨同类，只分辨大小
lines.en: I tell not kin from foe, only size.

lines.zh: 撞在一起的那一下，我们分不清
lines.en: In the moment we meet, we cannot be told apart.
We join, then part.

lines.zh: 分出来的那一半，也算我
lines.en: What splits off is still partly me.
This is not feeling; it is stickiness.
We envelop each other a while.
After parting, each finds its own food.
A large slick of slime remains.
A common purpose is enough.
I wrap it up.
It slowly dissolves inside.
I need no hands to take things.
Too hard; it will not dissolve.

lines.zh: 我把它推到我身体中间
lines.en: I push it into the middle of me.
I already have a heap of these inside.
It presses against me, unpleasant.
I spit it back out.

lines.zh: 这个我留着，别的时候吃
lines.en: I keep this one for later.

lines.zh: 你看见我里面的东西了吗
lines.en: Did you see what is inside me?
I feel that little patch of warmth.
I hop twice that way.
It is only a step away.

lines.zh: 我不需要快，我只要黏上
lines.en: I need no speed; only contact.
I spread out for more area.

lines.zh: 我把你脚边的土弄湿了。
lines.en: The soil at your feet is already wet.

lines.zh: 我这一下要跳到你身上
lines.en: I am going to hop onto you.

lines.zh: 地上已经有我的黏液了
lines.en: My slime is already on the ground.

lines.zh: 我跟着你踩过的草过来。
lines.en: The grass you stepped on is still moving.
I am oozing toward you.
One hop, a little closer.

lines.zh: 你退到石头上，我还是能过去
lines.en: You back onto stone; I can still get there.

lines.zh: 我的黏液先铺到你脚边
lines.en: My slime reaches your feet first.
I am not in a hurry; I stick.
Run fast and you will slip.
I keep leaning your way.
My body is swelling.
I flatten down and gather for the hop.
Nowhere left to dodge.
I have stuck again.

lines.zh: 我一跳，整个拍在你身上
lines.en: I leap and slap down onto you.
My slime burns the skin.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也溅开了
lines.en: That splashed me apart too.

lines.zh: 我压上去，把你的腿裹住
lines.en: I press over and wrap your leg.
You shake, but it will not come off.
I rise and leap again.

lines.zh: 我身上带着腐土的味道
lines.en: I carry the smell of rotten earth.
That little contact was enough.
I pull back and flatten again.
Two steps and you will slip.

lines.zh: 地上多了一大摊紫黑的东西
lines.en: A large purple-black puddle appears.
I swell up out of the earth.

lines.zh: 这里的土是腐的，正合适
lines.en: The soil here is rotten; just right.
I spread out first, then rise.

lines.zh: 我的气泡一拍一拍地破
lines.en: My bubbles pop, one beat at a time.
No one wants to touch me.
I squeeze out from between stones.

lines.zh: 腐化已经把这片地吃透了
lines.en: The corruption has already soaked this ground.
I head toward the movement.

lines.zh: 我在地上留了一道亮痕
lines.en: A shining trail marks my path.

lines.zh: 火烤干我的表面，我缩成一团
lines.en: Fire dries my surface; I shrink into a lump.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，摔得摊开
lines.en: I fall from height and splatter flat.

lines.zh: 我一直在湿的地方，可这水太多了
lines.en: I like damp, but this is too much water.
The blast scatters me into several pieces.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过去，留了个洞
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 那股力把我的黏液烤硬了
lines.en: That force bakes my slime hard.

lines.zh: 我很久没包住过东西了
lines.en: I have not wrapped anything in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，整摊都在抖
lines.en: Lightning hits me and the whole pool shudders.
No ground beneath me; I come apart.
